en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard composed of nine small photographs of city scenes. Captions in German label various locations: a grand outdoor staircase and landscaped garden in the Stadtpark, a river scene on the Elbe with a steamboat and industrial riverside buildings, a remaining section of an old city wall in the park, large multi‑storey former military barracks (Ehem. 32er‑Kaserne), a circular landscaped square labeled Adolf Hitler‑Platz surrounded by buildings, a tree‑lined path in the city park called Brandenburger Weg, a large arched steel bridge over the Elbe (Elbbrücke), and additional views of the Stadtpark. A red number "26367" is handwritten in the upper right margin.
